scope: Measurement H (configs/protocol.json part 2): cuda5; u4m (src/cuda_range_v3.cu defaults, radix at every k) on the full collection (8,841,823 passages); W in 256 512 1024 2048 4096; k in 10 100 316 1000; timed cells W >= k (amendment 1; logs/timed-cells.tsv); 500 calibration queries; 3 processes per cell x (3 + 20 rounds), W rotated within k; diagnostic clock profile at k=10 for W in 256 1024 4096; holder-based idle rule; calibration only, after the freeze
recording: not recorded by the team runtime; self-recorded manifest

public_packaging.convention: Team layout on main: raw per-query .csv/.tsv over 1 MB are stored as lossless .gz; full profiler reports, JIT caches and listings too large for Git stay outside Git with their SHA-256; 'artifacts' above still lists every file exactly as produced.
